SELECT c.customerid AS customerId, c.customername AS customerName, c.email AS email, c.phone AS phone, c.prefecture AS prefecture, c.city AS city, c.registeredat AS registeredAt, c.membershiptier AS membershipTier, c.createdat AS createdAt, COALESCE(s.ordercount, 0) AS orderCount, COALESCE(s.totalspent, 0) AS totalPurchaseAmount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.ordercount, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(s.totalspent, 0) / s.ordercount END AS averageOrderAmount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN v_customerOrderStats s ON s.customerid = c.customerid WHERE c.customerid = #{customerId}
